title: Washing away germs
examples: Do germs really make us sick?
How long should I wash my hands for?
What is the best soap to use?

explain.say: Germs are tiny living things you cannot see.
Germs can live on surfaces like doorknobs and toys.
Soap helps to trap and wash germs away from your hands.

draw.text: Soap traps and washes away germs.

explain.say: You should wash your hands for a full twenty seconds.
When you wash your hands, scrub between your fingers well.
In real life, you wash your hands before eating snacks.

items: Before eating | Germs are on hands

faq.q: Why do we need to wash our hands?
faq.a: We wash our hands to take away tiny germs that can make us sick. You might also ask, what is the purpose of hand washing? Or, how do I get rid of germs?
asks: Why do we wash our hands?
What is the purpose of hand washing?
How do I get rid of germs?

faq.q: How long should I wash my hands for?
faq.a: You should scrub your hands for a count of twenty seconds. This is about singing the 'Happy Birthday' song twice. You could also ask, what is the correct time for hand washing? Or, how long must I scrub?
asks: How long should I wash my hands for?
What is the correct time for hand washing?

faq.q: Is soap important for washing germs?
faq.a: Yes, soap is very important because it helps to trap the germs. It helps the water wash the soap and the germs away. You might also ask, does soap help clean germs? Or, should I use soap?
asks: Is soap important for washing germs?

faq.q: Can I just rinse with water?
faq.a: No, rinsing with water alone is not enough to wash away all the germs. You must use soap with the water to clean properly. You could ask, is water enough to clean hands? Or, do I need soap?
asks: Can I just rinse with water?
Is water enough to clean hands?

faq.q: When should I wash my hands?
faq.a: You should wash your hands before eating and after using the bathroom. Washing hands after playing outside is also a good time. You could ask, when is it best to wash hands? Or, after what activities should I wash?
asks: When should I wash my hands?
When is it best to wash hands?
After what activities should I wash?

facts: Germs are too small to be seen with the naked eye.
Soap helps lift and trap germs so water can wash them away.
Washing hands for twenty seconds is the recommended time.
You should wash hands before eating and after using the toilet.
